description.value: New Horizon Motel is a family-run, 25-room property in Christina Lake, BC, situated directly on Highway 3 (Crowsnest) and the Trans Canada Trail. The motel offers a range of room types from standard sleeping units to two-bedroom suites with full kitchens, and serves a complimentary continental breakfast to guests. It sits at a natural crossroads for cyclists exploring the Kettle Valley Railroad Trail, Grand Forks Community Trail, and Paulson Pass routes, with Christina Lake—one of the warmest lakes in Canada—just minutes away.

address.value: 2037 Hunter Frontage Road, Christina Lake, BC V0H 1E2

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and provides detailed amenity information for the New Horizon Motel in Christina Lake. Wi-Fi is explicitly confirmed ('Free WiFi', 'wireless internet' throughout). No mention of bike storage, laundry, drying areas, bike tools, or e-bike charging anywhere on the site. Phone and address in OSM match the website exactly (250-447-9312 and 2037 Hunter Frontage Road); the website also lists a toll-free number not in OSM. The most recent TripAdvisor awards cited are from 2013–2014, suggesting the website has not been substantially updated in years, though the site itself is live and functional.
concerns: Most recent TripAdvisor awards cited are from 2013–2014; website content appears significantly outdated and may not reflect current amenities or services.
Fax number inconsistency across subpages: /maps.htm and /index.htm list 250-447-9488 while /roomform.htm lists 250-447-9486.
Website lists a toll-free number (1-888-859-0159) not present in OSM tags.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, operating motel with an active website, confirmed address, and strong trail access making it directly relevant to touring cyclists in the Boundary/Kootenay region.
